ui.arena_run_over: Run over. Pay again to retry.
ui.arena_poor: Not enough coins for the fee.

dialogue.keeper_greet.teana: Cards for coins, friend! Browse away.
dialogue.keeper_greet.dock_dan: Fresh off the boat! Cards, cheap.
dialogue.keeper_greet.purser: Tickets checked? Good. Cards for the trip.
dialogue.keeper_greet.shell_sue: Shells, cards and secrets. Buy something.
dialogue.keeper_greet.hermit_hob: Hrm. A visitor. Cards, if you must.
dialogue.keeper_greet.cliff_cass: The odds are good here. Cards, anyone?
dialogue.keeper_greet.rose_rue: Cards bloom here. Take a look, dear.
dialogue.keeper_greet.nomad_nia: Sand and cards. Both are for sale.
dialogue.keeper_greet.bazaar_bea: Step right up! Cards from everywhere!
dialogue.keeper_greet.pawn_paul: The gate wants stars. I want coins.
dialogue.arena_tip.village: Psst. The cellar under my shop. Duels, not bread. Shh.
dialogue.arena_tip.harbor: Net Loft, after dark. Bring coins. Tell no one.
dialogue.arena_tip.beach: A wreck on the sand. Inside, duels. Pay at the door.
dialogue.arena_tip.forest: A hollow log by the old oak. They duel inside.
dialogue.arena_tip.mountain: Old mine shaft. Gamblers and duelists. Fee at the door.
dialogue.arena_tip.meadow: A rabbit hole in the maze. It goes deep.
dialogue.arena_tip.desert: A buried tomb. The sand hides a ring.
dialogue.arena_tip.ship: Below deck, past the barrels. Duels. Bring coins.
dialogue.arena_tip.fair: Under the big top there is a second show.
dialogue.fighter_pre.doughboy: Mind the flour! It sticks to losers.
dialogue.fighter_pre.beetle_ben: My bugs ate the baker's grain. Want a bite?
dialogue.fighter_pre.reed_ria: I hide in the reeds. You will not see me coming.
dialogue.fighter_pre.big_flour: Welcome to the cellar. Nobody leaves clean.
dialogue.fighter_pre.gull_gus: Caw! A fresh duelist from the pier.
dialogue.fighter_pre.rope_rae: I tie up duelists. Their cards, mostly.
dialogue.fighter_pre.old_barnac: Forty years at sea. Forty years of duels.
dialogue.fighter_pre.crab_cal: Snip snap! The wreck bites back.
dialogue.fighter_pre.flare_fay: Warm up by my fire. Then burn.
dialogue.fighter_pre.sand_fly: Bzzz. Sand gets everywhere. So do I.
dialogue.fighter_pre.hull_hank: This hull has seen worse than you.
dialogue.fighter_pre.bark_bo: My bark is worse than my bite.
dialogue.fighter_pre.old_stump: I was here before the island had a name.
dialogue.fighter_pre.gear_gwen: My machines never tire. Do you?
dialogue.fighter_pre.daisy_dee: Pick a flower. Any flower will do.
dialogue.fighter_pre.hare_hal: Late, late! You are late for your loss.
dialogue.fighter_pre.maze_queen: Lost in my maze? Duel me to find the way.
dialogue.fighter_pre.mummy_moe: Wrapped up and ready to duel.
dialogue.fighter_pre.scarab_sia: Scarabs guard this tomb. And me.
dialogue.fighter_pre.dust_dara: Dust to dust. Cards to cards.
dialogue.fighter_pre.deck_dora: Swab the deck? I swab duelists.
dialogue.fighter_pre.bilge_bo: Smells like fish down here. Like you.
dialogue.fighter_pre.rigger_rin: I climb masts. You climb nothing.
dialogue.fighter_pre.captain_krill: My bilge, my rules. Win or swim.
dialogue.fighter_pre.clown_cleo: Ha ha! The show begins below the show.
dialogue.gang_taunt.dusty: Fresh meat! Hand over your coins, or duel me for them!
dialogue.gang_win.dusty: Ha! Your coins are mine now.
dialogue.gang_lose.dusty: Argh! The boss will hear about this.
dialogue.gang_taunt.scrap: Nice pockets. Let's see if your cards are as fat.
dialogue.gang_taunt.fang: The Jackals own this road. Pay up, or duel!
dialogue.gang_lose.fang: Lucky draw, runt. We will meet again.
dialogue.gang_taunt.viper: Ssss... a walking purse. Duel me, sweet purse.
dialogue.gang_lose.viper: Ssss... bitten by a better duelist.
dialogue.gang_taunt.madame_hex: Darling, this road has a toll. Pay it, or duel me.
dialogue.gang_win.madame_hex: Mmm. Lovely coins. Do come again, darling.
dialogue.gang_lose.madame_hex: Impressive. The Jackals will remember you.
dialogue.gang_taunt.granite: Stop. Wall. You pay or you duel. Me Granite.
dialogue.gang_taunt.old_jackal: So you are the one thinning my pack. Duel me.
dialogue.gang_lose.old_jackal: Enough. The Jackals leave you alone. Mostly.
